name: noter-monorepo
description: noter monorepo with PNPM and Vite+ tooling

scripts.check: pnpm run check:workspace && pnpm run check:root
scripts.check:ci: pnpm run check:workspace:ci && pnpm run check:root
scripts.check:scripts: pnpm run typecheck:scripts && pnpm run lint:scripts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter noter typecheck && pnpm --filter noter-starter-template typecheck && pnpm typecheck:scripts
scripts.ci:convex-bootstrap: CONVEX_AGENT_MODE=anonymous pnpm --filter noter exec convex dev --until-success --typecheck=disable --tail-logs=disable
scripts.clean: rm -rf .turbo .vite coverage test-results apps/noter/dist apps/noter/dev-dist apps/noter/e2e/test-results apps/noter/e2e/live-test-results apps/noter-starter-template/dist
scripts.test:ci: pnpm test && PLAYWRIGHT_VITE_PORT=43121 pnpm --filter noter test:visual
scripts.lint:scripts: pnpm exec oxlint --config .oxlintrc.json --tsconfig tsconfig.scripts.json --report-unused-disable-directives runtime scripts .devcontainer/postcreate.ts apps/noter/scripts apps/noter-agent-template/scripts apps/noter-starter-template/scripts apps/noter-starter-template/.devcontainer/postcreate.ts apps/noter/tailwind.config.ts apps/noter-starter-template/tailwind.config.ts
